#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1:** …
and the conjunction
 of good and truth sur
passes all
 else
;
 the divine
 truth
 proceeding through
 these states speaks
 beyond
 what
 can
 be measured
.


**¶3:** This
 quality
, which the
 heavenly communities
 called
 "proven
 in
 essence
"
 —
 they
 recognized its
 nature
 within
 the infinite
 states of wisdom.
 The
 inn
umerable goods
 and
 truths of heaven distinguished
 it and
 set it apart,
 and
 it proceeded
 out
ward to combat fals
ity and
 evil
.
 They
 gave it
 this essential
 quality because
 the
 goods
 and truths dwelling
 within the
 states
 of wisdom are beyond
 all
 finite
 measure or
 enum
eration.

**¶4:**
 This quality, which they called "the
 conjunction
 of good and truth itself
,"
 was
 so
 named
 because it is the first and
 in
most state
 of innocence in
 which good and truth are perfectly united
 with
 no admixture of self-love
 or falsity —
 throughout
 all the states
 belonging
 to wisdom
 and interior perception.
 By
 that
 perception
 they
 recognized
 its
 nature, so that…


**¶5:** This quality
,
 which they also
 called "the sole
 proce
eding,"
 was so
 named
 because it was
 established as
 the one thing that issues
 directly from the Divine itself…
 against
 all
 that
 opp
oses it.


**¶7:** And
 just
 as the unique
 things
 proce
eding from the
 Divine
 proceed
 also
 through
 your
 own
 regener
ate
 line
age,
 and
 through
 the external
 natural
 mind
 —
 so likewise
 does
 what
 uniqu
ely proceeds come
 forth
 through
 celest
ial good and spiritual truth and
 through every
 form
 of good and truth in the whole
 created
 order.

**¶8:**
 Just as the
 Divine
 Love itself —
 the in
most celestial principle — stood
 firm in its
 integrity
 while wholly
 surrounded by all states of falsity and
 evil:
 it
 did not conj
oin itself
 with those
 states of
 fals
ity,
 nor did the
 will
 inc
line toward them in
 any way. Rather
, its interior
 perception and its
 entire
 will were directed toward
 the goods and truths of the interior
 spiritual
 mind —
 toward
 the whole
 of
 the church within
.
 Whatever
 else
 the power
 of evil
 attempted
 through
 the
 force
 of self-love and comp
ulsion —
 be
hold, the Divine
 Love
 lab
ors and underg
oes spiritual combat so
 that evil
 may
 be separated from those
 interior
 goods and truths,
 and fals
ity may be cast out from them entirely
.
 And
 it purifies them and liber
ates them from their bondage to fals
ity, and rest
ores them to the
 celest
ial state they
 possessed
 from the beginning.

**¶
10:** …may they recover
 the living
 perception
 of the goods
 and truths of the interior mind —
 those
 of
 the Lord
's own
 household
 — as the
 Divine
 Love
 remains present
 within
 this state
 through
 all conditions
 of obscurity and of
 illumin
ation,
 without
 ce
asing.
